regime: Metals steadying after forced selling, with silver still under extra stress and the tech-led selloff on hold before Nvidia
takeaway: Gold was roughly flat near $3,857 early Tuesday and silver bounced about 1.7% to near $47.70, but the gold/silver ratio is still above 80, the level the site treats as silver under extra stress. Stock futures were mixed after Monday's 2.5% Nasdaq drop, the VIX is still elevated near 23, and October retail sales rose 0.2% as expected while the core measure beat at 0.6%. Yields, the dollar and the yen barely moved, so Nvidia's results after the close and Wednesday's Fed minutes are the next tests.
